queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Audacity %' AND publisher = 'Audacity';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Audacity %' AND publisher = 'Audacity' AND version_compare(version, '4.0.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) IN ('audacity.exe','audacity4.exe'));
